svg.title: Adult coagulopathy decision chart: which clotting time is long (PT/INR only, aPTT only, or both) points to the extrinsic, intrinsic or common pathway; a mixing study splits a factor deficiency from an inhibitor, and the common-pathway causes split into liver disease and vitamin K lack or anticoagulants; each column gives causes and clues, how to confirm, and what to do next
